tablebase_path.description: Absolute filesystem path to the directory containing Gaviota tablebase files (.gtb)

preload_limit.description: Maximum number of tablebase files to preload into memory on startup (0 means load on demand, i.e., lazy loading)

compression.description: Enable support for compressed tablebases (e.g., .gtb.gz). Disable only if all files are uncompressed.

debug.description: Enable verbose diagnostic logging to stderr during tablebase initialization and lookups.

items.description: A glob or substring pattern (e.g., 'KQvK', '5men') used to filter which tablebase files to preload. Matches against filenames (without path or extension).

preload_patterns.description: Optional list of patterns to selectively preload only matching tablebase subsets (e.g., 'KQvK', '4men'). Leave empty to preload all available.
